result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. Excluding the expected partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, one visual defect remains: the featured restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a loading spinner overlay stuck on top of an already-loaded image, which looks broken.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a circular loading spinner in the center of the card even though the ramen image behind it has fully loaded. A persistent spinner over loaded content looks like a stuck/broken loading state.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the card image/content has loaded; only show the loading indicator while assets are pending, then fade it out.

issues.description: The loading spinner (white circle with green arc) sits directly on top of the food photo without any dimming or backdrop, making it hard to distinguish from the image content and reducing perceived polish.
issues.suggestion: If a spinner is needed, place it over a subtle translucent scrim or skeleton placeholder so the loading state is visually distinct from loaded imagery.
